relationships.subject: pregabalin
relationships.evidence_quote: Pregabalin and gabapentin increased HO-1, arginase-1, and endogenous opioid precursor preproenkephalin gene expression and decreased the expression of glial markers, interleukin-1β, and inducible nitric oxide synthase.

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Pregabalin and gabapentin increased HO-1, arginase-1, and endogenous opioid precursor preproenkephalin gene expression and decreased the expression of glial markers, interleukin-1β, and inducible nitric oxide synthase.

relationships.subject: tin protoporphyrin IX
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of SnPP or ZnPP abolished the mechanical antiallodynic effects of pregabalin and gabapentin.

relationships.subject: HO-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1) signaling attenuates glial activation during neuropathic pain.

key_findings: Spinal HO-1 inhibition (SnPP/ZnPP, intrathecal) abolished the antiallodynic effects of pregabalin and gabapentin in SNI mice, while peripheral HO-1 inhibition did not.
Pregabalin and gabapentin increased HO-1, arginase-1 and preproenkephalin and decreased glial markers, IL-1β and iNOS.
